ideas.how: Ranked by $ an hour, then the time to the first dollar, for a non-coder with a PC and Claude. Numbers are the search engine's reading of blogs and aggregators (most have affiliate interests): treat them as rough.

rows.name: AI training tasks (rating and writing for AI companies)
rows.risk: No guaranteed hours; projects come and go; many applicants are never given work; pay per task on some sites. Using an AI to do the tasks is banned and gets the account closed.
rows.fits: Your own time at the PC, in English; no selling, no audience. Claude can only help you prepare the application, never do the tasks.

rows.name: Paid website and app tests (record your screen and voice)
rows.first_dollar: 2-3 weeks (a practice test, then PayPal about 14 days after a test)
rows.risk: Few tests a week for a new tester; you must match the screener; a 20-minute test pays about $10, flat-rate sites $5.
rows.fits: A PC with a microphone, 20 minutes at a time, nothing to build.

rows.name: AI set-up and automation gigs for small businesses (Fiverr)
rows.first_dollar: 2-8 weeks (new sellers wait for the first order)
rows.risk: Crowded; Fiverr keeps 20%; the client must be told AI is used. Fiverr's own index: AI automation +136%, prompt work +76%.
rows.fits: Builds on the 8 ready gigs (docs/GIG_PACK.md); Claude drafts, you check and send.

rows.name: Disclosed prop-firm affiliate links (the eval journal, the product shop page)
rows.risk: Needs followers first; 'Ad' on every link (FTC); no results or pass claims; firm rules on affiliates differ. Reported rates 5-25% of the eval fee, often recurring (vendor blogs, unverified).
rows.fits: You already trade these evals and have the eval journal plan.

rows.name: More spreadsheet / printable templates (Etsy, Payhip)
rows.risk: Most template sellers make little; volume comes from many listings and search; Etsy charges $0.20 a listing.
rows.fits: Claude builds them; you upload (the 8 products are the start).

rows.name: Print on demand (shirts, mugs with your designs)
rows.risk: Most stores fail; 6-12 months to profit in the guides; ads cost money. Not recommended now.

ai_training.title: AI training tasks: starter kit
steps: Pick 2 well-known sites that pay for AI rating / writing work (search 'AI training jobs remote'); read their own pay and rules page first
Apply with your real name; take the assessment in one quiet sitting (30-90 min); write in your own words
Never pay to apply or to 'unlock' work: real sites pay you, never the other way
When work comes: 1-2 hours on weekday evenings, after the market closes; log hours and $ in the Ledger
Set aside 25-30% for taxes (you are a contractor: no tax is taken out)
rules: Do the tasks yourself: using an AI to answer AI-training tasks is banned and ends the account
One account per person, your real identity
Keep task content private (they sign you to confidentiality)
ai_training.money: About $15-30 an hour for general English tasks when work is there (ZipRecruiter average $27.67 for remote annotation); hours are never guaranteed.

user_testing.title: Paid website tests: starter kit
steps: Sign up on 2 tester sites with your real details; do the practice test well (it decides if you get tests)
Have a quiet room, a working microphone and the PC ready; tests appear in the site's feed with the pay shown first
Think out loud: say what you see, what you expect and what confuses you; that is the whole job
Take only tests whose screener honestly fits you (lying gets the account closed)
PayPal pays about 14 days after a test; log each test in the Ledger
rules: Never share the sites' or clients' private content
user_testing.money: About $10 for a 20-minute recorded test ($5 flat on some sites, $30-120 for rare live interviews); a new tester often gets only a few a week.

rules: Nothing here posts, emails, uploads or calls by itself: you press every button.
Every $ is an ESTIMATE range from research, not income; 'real' is only what the ledger recorded.
No paid services: every account on this page is a free plan (Etsy's $0.20 listing fee is the one optional cost).
